## Checklist

- [ ] No generated artifacts committed (`runs/`, `screenshots/`, `*.loupe`, `report.html`, `opportunities.json`, implementation packages, memory files)
- [ ] No unnecessary new docs/specs/evals added (see CONTRIBUTING.md — spikes only when requested)
- [ ] Tests updated only where behavior changed
- [ ] Docs updated only for user-facing behavior changes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run repo:check` passes
